9.Matt Yates scored some great double wins over 800 and 1,500 metres. Pictured at Copthall where he had already taken the 'A' 800 event, he controls the 'B' 1,500m before sprinting away from the field.

Matt Yates (right) gave one of his best ever Games performances in Budapest, placing 6th in a highly tactical 1500 metres final. John Mayock (left) was 5th and Tony Whiteman (centre) was 4th. No medals but it was great to see all three Brits well in contention in a European Games final again.
